title: Basis Note: The Equity Standing on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account at the Moment It Is Signed Over
content:
What the equity standing is read from turns on what the equity ledger carries for the year most recently allocated.

**Where a restatement stands.** Where a restatement stands on the equity ledger for the year most recently allocated, the equity standing is the ledger's equity portions and capital retains with the equity portion of the restated allocation put in the place of the equity portion credited for that year, less everything revolved out, rounded to two decimal places. The equity portion of the restated allocation is that allocation taken at the class's own equity percentage, rounded to two decimal places.

**Where none stands and a balance is recorded.** Where no restatement stands for the year most recently allocated and an equity balance stands recorded on the membership above nothing, the equity standing is that recorded balance.

**Otherwise.** The equity standing is the ledger's equity portions and capital retains less everything revolved out, rounded to two decimal places.

## The three readings on hypothetical figures

Take equity portions of 9400.00 and capital retains of 1260.00 credited on the ledger, 2150.00 revolved out, an equity portion of 820.00 credited for the year most recently allocated, and an equity balance of 8000.00 recorded on the membership.

| What the ledger carries for the year most recently allocated | Equity standing |
| --- | --- |
| a restatement of 1600.00 on a class whose equity percentage is 70 | 9400.00 and 1260.00 added, 820.00 taken off and 1120.00 put in its place, 2150.00 taken off: 8810.00 |
| no restatement, and 8000.00 recorded on the membership | 8000.00 |
| no restatement, and nothing recorded on the membership | 8510.00 |

**On the second reading.** The recorded balance must stand above nothing; where it stands at nothing the last reading is the one that governs, and the ledger is what the equity standing is read from.

This is the reckoning Membership and Patronage Equity uses for the equity standing on a membership at the moment it is signed over.
